rules.statement: A co-owner cannot bring an action for a declaration of title to a share of a building without the proper legal foundation, such as a notarial agreement or prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear beyond doubt that our law does not recognize the ownership of a building apart from the land on which it stands. In Samaranayake v. Mendoris 1[1 (1928) 30 N. L. R. 203.] Drieberg so held, and, if I may adopt some words in his judgment, if at the to this theatre building was erected the plaintiff had no interest in the land he cannot possibly be owner of the building in any sense, for it because the property of the soil-owner."
